definitions.explanation: A natural or man-made channel through which water flows. Includes irrigation channels, drainage ditches, canals, and navigable waterways.

examples.japanese: {水路|すいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

⟦{農業|のうぎょう}{用|よう}→農業用：26729_nougyouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水路|すいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Agricultural waterways supply water to the rice paddies.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{造|つく}られた→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧{水路|すいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Waterways built in the Edo period still remain in this town.

notes:
USAGE:
{水路|すいろ} is a general term covering both natural and artificial water channels. Compare with ⟦{運河|うんが}→運河：04002_unga⟧ (canal), which specifically refers to large man-made waterways for navigation or transport, and ⟦{用水路|ようすいろ}→用水路：19104_yousuiro⟧ (irrigation channel), which is specifically for agricultural water supply. {水路|すいろ} can refer to any of these.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水路|すいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a waterway
- {水路|すいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to maintain waterways
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}{用|よう}→農業用：26729_nougyouyou⟧{水路|すいろ}: agricultural waterway
- {水路|すいろ}⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧: nautical chart
